title: CM Shivakumar announces AI education programme for schools in Karnataka
description: He said his government has already formulated programmes to transform the skills of today's youth and enable them to compete globally, adding that AI education would be introduced in schools across Karnataka from Class 6. Shivakumar said the government was also working on establishing India's first government-owned AI university in Bengaluru.

title: Why Japanese firms are slow to adopt AI
description: Facing acute labour shortages, an ageing population and long-standing productivity problems, Japan would appear to be an ideal environment for the adoption of artificial intelligence (AI).
